verify-summary-lane.description: Lane-required evidence check on one or more SUMMARY.md targets (slug or path); never runs Verify commands.

verify-summary-check.description: Re-run the Verify table of specs/<slug>/SUMMARY.md and compare claimed vs actual exits without rewriting the file.

check-verify-rows.description: Lint SUMMARY/PLAN Verify and SC rows: pipe-free and under the 60 s strict-gate cap. No exit-2 path.

check-review-receipt.description: Validate specs/<slug>/.review-receipt.json against the current git HEAD (optionally --require t1,t2).
